chapters.text: Shopping for the woman on your list who always has her hands full? The wrapping paper, the coffee, the gloves, the keys. Give her a bag that keeps up with all of it.
Here it is, out of the tissue paper. Watch the clasp. One snap with one hand and it's shut, even with a coffee in the other hand.
Now open it up. There's a spot for her phone, her wallet and her keys, each in its own place, so nothing ends up lost at the bottom.
And the strap adjusts. Short, she carries it as a handbag to Christmas lunch. Long, it goes crossbody for a walk round the Christmas market, both hands on the shopping.
The Vintage Bag is fifty percent off right now, with free shipping. One gift crossed off your list, and one she can carry every day. Tap the link below.

chapters.text: Saturday morning at the Christmas market. Lights everywhere, people everywhere, and your arms already full. Wear the strap long and the bag goes crossbody, so both hands are there for the paper bags and a hot chocolate.
At the stall, you pay without putting a thing down. Your card comes out, the flap goes back over, and one snap with one hand shuts it again.
Lunch in a busy cafe, the table crowded with cups and shopping. Inside the bag, your phone, wallet and keys each sit in their own spot, so nothing sinks to the bottom while you look for them.
Evening, the office party. Shorten the strap and it's a neat little handbag again, the same bag that did the market this morning. No swapping bags, no keys left behind in the other one.
